I've had several appointments there for my dog, and it's always been excellent!
Great service.

My dog ​​went to this clinic for a consultation. The veterinarian prescribed antibiotics and anti-inflammatories before actually doing any tests or referring her to the specialist, a dermatologist, who determined that she didn't need those medications, meaning my dog ​​took 11 days of medication in vain. When I showed her how drastically her condition worsened, she told me to stop the medication. The clinic also wanted to charge me an exorbitant and abusive amount to see their specialist.

I hired their therapeutic bath service as instructed by the doctor, and they didn't provide it.
It was a horrible experience; I don't recommend it. The professionals at this place should improve their skills and be more responsible with the animals.
I don't recommend this clinic to anyone.
Terrible customer service via WhatsApp, they don't respond.

It's been excellent. My dog ​​is going into his fourth month of training and the progress is visible. The hotel is wonderful, I leave my pet there with peace of mind knowing he's being very well taken care of. I'm very happy with their work. I highly recommend them.
Thank you so much for your excellent review 🐾❤️ …

I only had one good experience with them, never again. Their WhatsApp customer service is terrible: they often don't respond, and when they do, it seems like they didn't even read what was written.

They also quoted me a much higher price for the shower than the first time, and then said they had given me the wrong information. Furthermore, there are never any available times for a shower. They give you another number to call, but nobody answers.

Unfortunately, the experience was very frustrating and I don't intend to return.
We loved the place and have been visiting ever since!

I really enjoyed the hotel, my dog ​​felt right at home! Thank you for the attention of the staff and the young men who answered all my questions and supported me whenever I needed anything. Incredible, congratulations on the service provided!
🐾 Thank you very much 🐾🐾 …
I highly recommend them; they are loving and very responsible with pets.

A company of excellent quality, Dog Therapy always surprises me with good results.

Whether working there or being served, the place always offers something special on holidays, has promotions for regular customers and also for those who stay for shorter periods, first-rate food, and is very attentive to each and every dog ​​that comes to the park – nothing but praise.
I leave my pets alone whenever I need to, without hesitation!

I found this daycare through a recommendation and now I highly recommend it! The staff are super nice, attentive, and treat the pets with so much love. They organize lots of games throughout the day, send photos for us to follow along, and even take the time to prepare little gifts for special occasions. The care and love they put into their work is evident. I recommend them without hesitation.
I left my dog ​​there and I recommend them. They are excellent professionals and everything is very well structured to better receive our animals. Congratulations! 👏👏 …
Great environment and fantastic staff, the best place to leave your pet.
Thank you 🐾🐾❤️❤️ …
Excellent treatment and attention from the professionals.

At Terapia Dog, they have everything our dogs need. They have a team of highly trained professionals who take great care of our furry friends... from managing their energy... everything at the right time, from feeding and training. I definitely feel safe with my dog ​​at Terapia Dog. 😊 …

I do not recommend this place and my dogs will never stay there again.

Edit after company response: They may not have found my registration, but I have no reason to lie. My dogs stayed with you for a while, and my dog ​​came back with a cut neck and a cough. I was traveling for a week and didn't receive updates on their condition every day, even after asking several times. There was one time I went almost two days without receiving anything. I do not recommend them.

The dog therapy center is excellent, a place I trust my dog ​​Gohan to burn off his energy and play with his doggy friends. He's even learned to be a well-behaved dog, thanks to the lessons and patience of the daycare staff; they are wonderful and very caring people. I recommend it to anyone who wants to leave their dog happy and well-tired at the end of the day... haha...

Amazing company, great service.
My dog ​​and I loved it. 🐾😍❤️ …
Excellent daycare, the whole team was always very attentive. I left my dog ​​with them for a year and a half and didn't have any problems whatsoever.
